summary: Round 3 KISS (Estimate Editor = Measurement -> Scope -> Price -> Proposal, takeoff moved into the estimate). Backend regression: 50/50 pass (test_takeoff_core, test_quote_from_estimate, test_crud_estimates_quotes_delete, test_lead_workflow_quote_authz). Full UI E2E passed as owner on a TEST lead with a lead-primary office-verified measurement: Lead Detail Open/Create proposal buttons, roof-system auto-select, Waste 12% -> Calculate (Item/Quantity/Order table) -> Add to estimate (editor reloads, button becomes 'Update estimate'), price edit -> estimate-unsaved + Calculate disabled + takeoff-save-first, Save, tax change then Create proposal (saved first, tax 5% shows on QUO-0913) -> lands on /quotes/{id}/proposal, Share link (copied), Download PDF (file downloaded), Email (stub toast), back to lead, Mark sent, Accept -> Job created. Preview/apply payloads exactly match the old Takeoff page shape. Advanced has measurement version, template version, drip override, per-structure waste, used-versions note, changed-metrics and the full details table. Re-measure flow: a newer VERIFIED revision shows takeoff-use-latest, which switches correctly. Sales: read-only summary + takeoff-office-only, no cost/markup/GP even with details on, More shows 'No extra options', no Email button, can create a proposal. Setup page (/estimating/takeoff) has only default waste + templates (Version column, new/edit-new-version, plain labels) + usage note, no estimate picker. Old data: EST-1041 opens with lines and totals unchanged ($3,788.75), pending note shown, opens QUO-0883. Save on EST-1041 returns 409 'accepted quote' (data unchanged, checked by API diff). EST-1078, EST-1055 (price books) and EST-0042 (assembly + waste lines) show the same totals as the API. MAIN DEFECT: after any editor Save, 'Update estimate' adds DUPLICATE takeoff lines instead of replacing them, and the hand-edited 409 review can never show. This is a backend issue that was already there, but the new happy path (apply -> adjust price -> Save -> update) now hits it every time.

critical.issue: PUT deletes all EstimateLineItems and reinserts them with new ids (routers/estimates.py update_estimate). EstimateTakeoffLine.estimate_line_item_id then points at deleted rows. services/takeoff._existing_generated_state skips them, so generated_line_ids_to_replace=[] and review_required=false. Re-applying the takeoff APPENDS a second set of generated lines (reproduced in the UI: EST-1087 ended up with 3 'Underlayment' lines). The hand-edit protection (409 TAKEOFF_GENERATED_LINES_MODIFIED / takeoff-review-required / takeoff-replace-apply) cannot trigger after a save. Repro: tests/test_takeoff_reapply_after_save.py (1 pass, 1 FAIL).

minor.issue: No accepted-quote lock. PUT /estimates returns 409 'accepted quote' but takeoff apply returns 200 and adds lines to an estimate whose proposal is accepted (checked on a TEST estimate after accepting QUO-0913). The editor still shows Calculate/Add to estimate on such estimates, for example EST-1041. This gap was already in the backend.

ui_bugs.issue: The Waste % input column (w-16) is too narrow. The number input clips its value, so '12' shows as '1' and '10' shows as '1' (input scrollWidth 55 > clientWidth 46). Users will misread waste. Widen the column to about w-20, or hide the spinner and reduce padding.

status.latest_measurement_revision_id is the newest revision even when it is a draft. Repro: used rev1, rev2 verified, rev3 draft. The warning then says 'new measurements are waiting for verification. This estimate keeps the previous ones', and takeoff-use-latest is hidden even though rev2 is verified and newer than the used rev1. Fix: offer the newest verified revision when its revision_number is greater than status.measurement_revision_number.

'Materials on this estimate already come from these measurements.' shows whenever has_takeoff is true. It still shows after the user switches to a different or newer revision (use-latest or Advanced select), where it is wrong. Show it only when chosen.id === status.measurement_revision_id.

editable = status draft|sent ignores an accepted proposal. EST-1041 (QUO-0883 accepted) shows Save, Add item and Calculate as enabled, and Save then fails with a 409 toast. Consider disabling these when any proposal from this estimate is accepted. This behaviour was already there before Round 3.

integration_issues.flow: Calculate -> Add -> edit price -> Save -> Update estimate
integration_issues.issue: Duplicate generated lines, caused by the backend issue above. The UI toast says 'Estimate updated with N item(s)', but old lines are not replaced.

issues: Sonner toasts (top-right) cover the Share Link / Email / Download PDF toolbar for about 4s after any action, so a click on Download PDF is blocked by the 'Share link copied' toast. Move the toaster to bottom-right or offset it below the header.
takeoff-changed-metrics prints raw JSON with structure UUIDs (area_by_structure), which plain users cannot read (this was already like this).
More than 150 test price books (QA PB *, MP Default *, LA *) make the select hard to use. This is test-data pollution, not a code bug.

action_items: HIGH: Keep takeoff line links across estimate saves. Either (a) make PUT /api/estimates upsert lines by id (the frontend must send item ids, which load() currently drops), or (b) re-point EstimateTakeoffLine.estimate_line_item_id when lines are recreated. Then make tests/test_takeoff_reapply_after_save.py pass and check that the 409 review UI appears when a generated line was hand-edited.
Add the accepted-quote lock (_has_accepted_quote -> 409) to takeoff apply. In the editor, disable Calculate, Add item and Save when a proposal from this estimate is accepted.
Widen the el-waste input so 2-3 digit values are visible.
measurements-changed-warning: offer 'Use the new measurements' for the newest verified revision when the latest revision is an unverified draft.
Show takeoff-applied-note only when the chosen revision is the one used last time.
Optional: on ProposalPreview, move toasts so they do not cover the action toolbar.
critical_code_review_comments: RoofTakeoffPanel looks measurements up with exactly one key (lead_id, else property, else inspection), not a fallback chain. This matches the backend's lead-primary resolver, but note that EST-1041 now sees 1 verified revision via its lead where the old page saw 9 via the property (other leads' history). That is intended, but it is a visible behaviour change.

Lost from the old Takeoff page (minor): the preview header 'Measurement R# + Template v#' and the '+X SQ waste impact' badge, and the warning text 'Estimate used Revision X; current is Revision Y' (only the used revision appears now, in Advanced). The Order Qty column moved out of the details table into the simple table. Nothing else was lost: all payload fields, the 409 replace path, structure waste, drip override and the version selects are present.
EstimateEditor proposals list is loaded by est.lead_id only, so estimates without a lead never show 'Open proposal'. proposals[0] relies on the API's sort order.
generateQuote skips the save when the estimate is not editable but dirty, so edits are silently left out of the new proposal.
Takeoff.jsx default-waste input and Save button have no data-testid.

success_rate.backend: 98% (50/50 regression pass; 1 new regression test fails on the duplicate-lines defect)
success_rate.frontend: ~88% (all requested flows work; 2 medium and 2 low UI bugs, 1 high integration defect from the backend)

The only takeoff template is 'test' (rev 55918ca8..., assembly 'TEST Assembly 192c37' v2, 1 rule 'Underlayment', no material, so the price is $0). To build E2E fixtures, use _setup_round3_e2e.py (TEST lead + lead-primary verified measurement + empty estimate, ids in /tmp/r3.json). rca of the issue: Duplicate takeoff lines: services/takeoff.apply records EstimateTakeoffLine(estimate_line_item_id=<new line id>). routers/estimates.update_estimate runs DELETE FROM estimate_line_items WHERE estimate_id=... and reinserts every item without its id (the EstimateEditor payload has no ids). The links now point to rows that no longer exist. _existing_generated_state does `db.get(EstimateLineItem, id)`, gets None and `continue`s, so nothing is replaced and nothing is flagged as modified. The next apply inserts a fresh set. Repro: apply -> PUT estimate (any change) -> preview shows generated_line_ids_to_replace=[] -> apply -> 2x lines.
